bank.q: Do I need to give Fatoorah my bank password?
bank.a: No. You upload a statement you downloaded yourself. We never ask for bank credentials.

banks.a: Any bank that issues PDF statements. Automatic bank sync through Saudi Open Banking is coming soon.

safe.a: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest, access is limited to your account, and we never sell your information.

cancel.a: Yes. Paid plans can be cancelled at any time and you keep access until the end of the billing period.

SecurityPage.title: Security and privacy
SecurityPage.subtitle: How we protect your financial data.

noCredentials.title: No bank passwords
noCredentials.desc: Fatoorah works from statements you upload. We never see or store your banking login.

encryption.title: Encrypted everywhere
encryption.desc: Data is encrypted in transit with TLS and stored encrypted at rest.

isolation.title: Your data stays yours
isolation.desc: Row-level access rules mean only your account can read your transactions.

delete.title: Delete anytime
delete.desc: Clear imported data from the app whenever you want. We don't sell data, ever.
